source.inspectionScope: Fresh full47-line three-file removal patch read. Fixed chat preference bindings inspected; exact literal absence checked only in three changed files, with retained log_ims positive controls. Full shared Bug umbrella retained context read, not all its other source patches.

text:
commit a6c8b591781b7f574a76a6745691d80c3610eeaa
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Apr 8 22:26:46 2025 +1200
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Tue Apr 8 22:26:46 2025 +1200

    Bug 1901705 - Remove remnants of pref purple.logging.log_system. r=mkmelin
    This pref used to do something. But that was a long time ago. Last seen in ESR 91.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D244735

diff --git a/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs b/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs
index 5d602345e57..b4aeb90c862 100644
--- a/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs
+++ b/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs
@@ -1378,7 +1378,6 @@ function reportPreferences() {
     "purple.conversations.im.send_typing",
     "purple.logging.log_chats",
     "purple.logging.log_ims",
-    "purple.logging.log_system",
 
     // Unlisted
     "mail.operate_on_msgs_in_collapsed_threads",
diff --git a/mail/components/preferences/chat.js b/mail/components/preferences/chat.js
index ea9c65e4e83..29fa9f8d56a 100644
--- a/mail/components/preferences/chat.js
+++ b/mail/components/preferences/chat.js
@@ -17,7 +17,6 @@ Preferences.addAll([
   { id: "messenger.status.defaultIdleAwayMessage", type: "wstring" },
   { id: "purple.logging.log_chats", type: "bool" },
   { id: "purple.logging.log_ims", type: "bool" },
-  { id: "purple.logging.log_system", type: "bool" },
   { id: "mail.chat.show_desktop_notifications", type: "bool" },
   { id: "mail.chat.notification_info", type: "int" },
   { id: "mail.chat.play_sound", type: "bool" },
diff --git a/mail/metrics.yaml b/mail/metrics.yaml
index ce720c30531..b85758ce5b9 100644
--- a/mail/metrics.yaml
+++ b/mail/metrics.yaml
@@ -250,7 +250,6 @@ mail:
       - purple.conversations.im.send_typing
       - purple.logging.log_chats
       - purple.logging.log_ims
-      - purple.logging.log_system
       - searchintegration.enable
       - signon.autologin.proxy
       - widget.gtk.overlay-scrollbars.enabled
